item.title: Form Spam Is a Systems Problem, Not a CAPTCHA Problem
item.description: Form spam is usually a weak workflow problem. Before adding a visible CAPTCHA, strengthen hidden fields, timing checks, origin rules, validation, and lead routing.

item.title: Every Website Form Needs Source Routing Before It Needs a CRM
item.description: Before connecting website forms to a CRM, add source routing, email redundancy, and test submissions so every lead path can be traced.
